set.descent_text: Parties rappel the route. The upper part has fixed belay stations, so the rappels there follow the climb; keep the ropes clear of the knobs, which catch them. At the large bivy ledge the rappel line leaves the climbing line and runs down a bolted line on the face, to the right of the chimneys, as far as the top of the third pitch, with a further rappel from there to the top of the first. Do not rappel into the chimney, where ropes jam, and since the stations on the open face are hard to spot, note the anchors on the way up.
set.approach: Base camp for the tower is at Fairy Meadows, in the Cirque of the Unclimbables. From camp, walk to the foot of the southeast face, crossing a snowfield on the way. The route begins at the well-defined left-facing corner that the first three pitches follow.

review.notes: Descent: route page and the Bell/Friberg topo page agree the route is rappelled with a bolted line right of the chimneys; approach (Fairy Meadows, snowfield) from the area page only; no times or counts written.
